title: Queries for a synthetic 200-account request
method: The first implementation performs 1 list query + 200 preference lookups. The second performs 1 list query + 1 batched preference query. Counts exclude unrelated queries and do not establish a latency multiplier.
alt: Queries for a synthetic 200-account request. Per-account lookup: 201 queries; Batched lookup: 2 queries. Illustrative inputs.
